title: Calculate the overall average first round and average last round of races m
question: Calculate the overall average first round and average last round of races missed by Formula 1 drivers across all years. Include only drivers who missed fewer than three races in a given year and who switched teams between their appearances immediately before and after their hiatus (i.e., the constructor ID for the race right before their first missed race must be different from the constructor ID for the race right after their last missed race in that year). Do not group results by year; return just the overall averages across the entire dataset.

prediction.sql:
WITH drv AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, MIN(first_round) AS fr, MAX(last_round) AS lr
  FROM drives
  GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
missed AS (
  SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, r.round AS missed_round
  FROM drv d
  JOIN races r ON r.year = d.year
  WHERE r.round > d.fr AND r.round < d.lr
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM drives dd
      WHERE dd.year = d.year AND dd.driver_id = d.driver_id AND dd.first_round <= r.round AND dd.last_round >= r.round
    )
),
missed_agg AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(*) AS n_missed, MIN(missed_round) AS first_missed, MAX(missed_round) AS last_missed
  FROM missed
  GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
before_after AS (
  SELECT m.year, m.driver_id, m.n_missed,
    (SELECT dd.constructor_id FROM drives dd
      WHERE dd.year=m.year AND dd.driver_id=m.driver_id AND dd.last_round = m.first_missed - 1
      ORDER BY dd.last_round DESC LIMIT 1) AS before_cid,
    (SELECT dd.constructor_id FROM drives dd
      WHERE dd.year=m.year AND dd.driver_id=m.driver_id AND dd.first_round = m.last_missed + 1
      ORDER BY dd.first_round ASC LIMIT 1) AS after_cid
  FROM missed_agg m
)
SELECT AVG(m.first_missed) AS avg_first, AVG(m.last_missed) AS avg_last
FROM missed_agg m
JOIN before_after b ON b.year=m.year AND b.driver_id=m.driver_id
WHERE m.n_missed < 3 AND b.before_cid IS NOT NULL AND b.after_cid IS NOT NULL AND b.before_cid <> b.after_cid

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH multi AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM drives
  GROUP BY year, driver_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.first_round, d.constructor_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, d.driver_id ORDER BY d.first_round) AS rn
  FROM drives d
  JOIN multi m ON m.year = d.year AND m.driver_id = d.driver_id
),
lasts AS (
  SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.last_round, d.constructor_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, d.driver_id ORDER BY d.last_round DESC) AS rn
  FROM drives d
  JOIN multi m ON m.year = d.year AND m.driver_id = d.driver_id
),
before_first AS (
  SELECT f.year, f.driver_id, f.first_round,
         (SELECT r.constructor_id
          FROM results r
          JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = r.race_id
          WHERE ra.year = f.year AND ra.round < f.first_round AND r.driver_id = f.driver_id
          ORDER BY ra.round DESC LIMIT 1) AS c_before
  FROM firsts f WHERE f.rn = 1
),
after_last AS (
  SELECT l.year, l.driver_id, l.last_round,
         (SELECT r.constructor_id
          FROM results r
          JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = r.race_id
          WHERE ra.year = l.year AND ra.round > l.last_round AND r.driver_id = l.driver_id
          ORDER BY ra.round ASC LIMIT 1) AS c_after
  FROM lasts l WHERE l.rn = 1
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT bf.year, bf.driver_id, bf.first_round, al.last_round
  FROM before_first bf
  JOIN after_last al ON al.year = bf.year AND al.driver_id = bf.driver_id
  WHERE bf.c_before IS NOT NULL AND al.c_after IS NOT NULL
    AND bf.c_before <> al.c_after
)
SELECT AVG(first_round) AS avg_first_round, AVG(last_round) AS avg_last_round
FROM qualifying
